Real-Time 3D & XR Developer (Unity / Unreal) — REDS, Bengaluru
Experience: 3–6 years
Key responsibilities
- Develop applications in Unity (C#) or Unreal Engine (Blueprints and C++) from prototype to production
- Build reusable frameworks for digital twins, product viewers and configurators
- Build AR apps with ARKit, ARCore and AR Foundation, VR builds for Meta Quest and PC VR, and WebXR experiences
- Optimise for target devices: frame rate, memory, 4K and 8K canvases, multi-display output and mobile thermals
- Load content and configuration from the platform so client teams can update a twin or product catalogue without a new build
- Connect to live data over REST, WebSockets and MQTT
- Define asset budgets and pipelines with the 3D artist (FBX, glTF/GLB, USD, LODs, lightmaps)
What you need
- 3–6 years of professional development in Unity or Unreal Engine, with shipped projects
- Strong C# or C++ and solid 3D maths (transforms, cameras, basic shaders)
- Experience with at least one of AR (ARKit, ARCore, AR Foundation) or VR (OpenXR, Meta Quest)
- Performance profiling and optimisation on real devices
- Git and day-to-day teamwork with designers and artists
- B.E./B.Tech, a degree in game development, or equivalent practical experience
Nice to have
- Digital twins, BIM/IFC import or architectural visualisation
- Pixel Streaming, WebGL or Three.js
- Shader Graph, HLSL, VFX Graph or Niagara
Skills: Unity, Unreal Engine, C#, C++, AR Foundation, ARKit, ARCore, OpenXR, WebXR, Digital Twin
